narrationTexts: I found the bug already: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` applies tax to the full `cents` instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the spec comment right above it. Let me confirm by running the suite first.

Confirmed: 3 failures, all in "order totals". As I suspected, `orderTotal` computes tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — only rows with both a non-zero discount and non-zero tax expose it. Fixing:
finalText:
All 625 cases pass now, exit code 0.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43` was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total, even though its own doc comment said tax should apply "on the amount the customer pays." Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. Most order-total test rows had a zero discount or zero tax, which masked the bug — only the 3 rows with both non-zero caught it.
